title: RepoRegistry
description: Schema for the .repos.json file maintained by `repo-cli`. Records cloned or registered Git repositories under the current working directory.

name.description: Repository name, derived from the clone URL or local directory name.

url.description: Git remote URL (origin). May be empty for repos discovered by `repo scan` that have no configured remote.

gitUrl.description: The Git URL for the repository.

readmeUrl.description: Optional URL pointing to the repository's README.md file.

path.description: Filesystem path to the local checkout (e.g. "C:\\workspace\\python\\repo-cli", "/home/user/repo-cli", or "$HOME/repo-cli"). May contain environment variables. May be empty if not yet cloned locally.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the record was first created (e.g. "2026-05-18T11:35:29Z").

githubMetadata.description: Cached metadata fetched from the GitHub API (`gh api repos/{repo.full_name}`).

data.description: The raw JSON response data from the GitHub API.

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the metadata was last fetched.
